overview: Balhae was founded by former Goguryeo people in Manchuria and became a major regional power known as the Flourishing State of the East. It maintained complex diplomatic relations with Tang China, Japan and neighboring peoples.

items.text: Diplomatic missions sent to Tang China, Japan and other regional powers.
Controlled trade routes connecting Manchuria to Korea, China and the steppe.
Chinese administrative models adapted to local conditions.
Its legacy claimed by Korea, China and Russia in modern historiography.
Archaeological sites reveal a sophisticated multi-ethnic state.

fall.text: The Khitan Liao dynasty conquered Balhae in 926 after a surprise military campaign.
